en: I just spotted you, Parker. You're almost there.
zh: 我刚看到你了，帕克，快到了。

en: Capek's somewhere in the center of this complex, Parker.
zh: 卡佩克就在这片建筑群的中心区域，帕克。

en: There are areas I can't see into. He's got to be in one of them.
zh: 有些区域我看不到，他肯定在其中之一。

en: I see Eos. She's on the other side of the complex, heading toward the center.
zh: 我看到伊欧丝了，她在建筑群的另一侧，正往中心去。

en: Try to meet her there. You can tackle Capek together.
zh: 设法在那儿跟她会合，你们可以一起对付卡佩克。

en: (scream)
Don't let him get away!
zh: 别让他跑了！

en: Parker, he's enabled the room's security monitors. I can see all three of you.
zh: 帕克，他打开了房间的监控，我能看到你们三个。

en: Parker, you made it. I don't know if Eos did.
zh: 帕克，你活下来了。伊欧丝就不知道了。

en: I'll ask Orion to contact me if Eos gets back to the base.
zh: 要是伊欧丝回到基地，我会让奥莱恩通知我。

en: I hope it's relatively clean for you.
zh: 希望那边对你来说还算干净。

en: You should be near the top of the canyon now.
zh: 你现在应该快到峡谷顶上了。

en: Take the cable car across the canyon. The comm center's on the other side.
zh: 坐缆车过峡谷，通讯中心在对面。

en: Once you're on the other side, you should be able to get into the basement of the comm center.
zh: 过去之后，你应该能进通讯中心的地下室。

en: Things are going badly for the Red Faction, Parker.
zh: 红色派系这边形势很不好，帕克。

en: They haven't done much so far, just probing miner positions, but that's not going to last.
zh: 他们目前还没什么大动作，只是在试探矿工的阵地，但撑不了多久。

en: And when I say we, I mean you, of course.
zh: 我说「我们」的时候，当然指的是你。

en: If we can disable the satellite control system, the fleet can come in and kick Ultor's butt.
zh: 只要能瘫痪卫星控制系统，舰队就能杀进来收拾乌尔托。

en: Look for an elevator or some other way up.
zh: 找找电梯，或者别的能上去的路。

en: Parker, get moving. Ultor's sending in reinforcements.
zh: 帕克，快走，乌尔托在派增援了。

en: Hurry up, Parker, there are more mercs coming.
zh: 快点，帕克，又有雇佣兵过来了。

en: You did it, Parker. Now get out of there.
zh: 你做到了，帕克，快离开那儿。

en: The tram station is right ahead of you. Get in there.
zh: 电车站就在你正前方，进去。

en: Those turrets are firing explosive rounds. Don't let them get a bead on you.
zh: 那些炮塔打的是爆炸弹，别让它们瞄上你。

en: But hurry up, the shuttle's leaving soon.
zh: 但要快，航天飞机马上就要走了。

en: I can't control the trams, you have to live with whatever schedule they're on.
zh: 电车我控制不了，只能按它自己的班次来。

en: There are mercs at the next platform. Duck down.
zh: 下一个站台有雇佣兵，蹲下。

en: Parker, are you at that shuttle yet? Hurry!
zh: 帕克，你到航天飞机那儿了吗？快点！

en: This area's crawling with mercs, so be careful.
zh: 这一带全是雇佣兵，小心点。

en: Hey, that's a merc armored personnel carrier. Those APCs kick butt.
zh: 嘿，那是雇佣兵的装甲运兵车，那玩意儿可猛了。

en: Grab it if you can.
zh: 能抢就抢过来。

en: The mercs know where our base is now.
zh: 雇佣兵现在知道我们基地在哪了。

en: They can take out that APC, so watch it.
zh: 他们能打掉那辆装甲车，当心点。

en: That should be less closely watched than the passenger doors.
zh: 那儿的看守应该比客运门松一些。

en: Hendrix says you're in the space station, Parker. Get that defense system down fast.
zh: 亨德里克斯说你进空间站了，帕克，尽快把防御系统弄掉。

en: The mercs are hitting our outlying posts hard. I've lost contact with three of them already.
zh: 雇佣兵正在猛攻我们的外围据点，已经有三个失去联系了。

en: Hurry, Parker, the EDF fleet's almost here.
zh: 快点，帕克，EDF舰队快到了。

en: I don't see any more guards. The miners and mercs must have wiped them out.
zh: 我看不到警卫了，应该是被矿工和雇佣兵清干净了。

en: I'm not seeing many miners left either.
zh: 矿工好像也没剩几个了。

en: If you overload the reactor, the explosion should destroy the station.
zh: 如果让反应堆过载，爆炸应该能摧毁整座空间站。

en: Shut off the cooling system first. Those controls should be in the lower section of the reactor.
zh: 先关掉冷却系统，控制装置应该在反应堆下层。

en: Good, now get back up to the regulator and set it to overload.
zh: 很好，现在回到调节器那儿，把它设成过载。

en: Now run, Parker!
zh: 快跑，帕克！

en: I've got a really bad feeling about this.
zh: 我有种很不好的预感。

en: Good, Parker. Now destroy the rest.
zh: 好，帕克，把剩下的也毁掉。

en: Okay, Parker, now find an escape pod and set the reactor to overload.
zh: 好了帕克，现在找个逃生舱，然后把反应堆设成过载。

en: Hurry, Parker. There should be escape pods in this section.
zh: 快，帕克，这一区应该有逃生舱。

en: Parker, these labs might have information we can use against Ultor. Check the computers if you have time.
zh: 帕克，这些实验室里可能有能用来对付乌尔托的资料。有空就查查电脑。

en: Great, Parker. We'll look at what you found later. For now, get off that station.
zh: 很好，帕克。你找到的东西我们回头再看，现在先离开空间站。

en: I don't know how long we can hold out. Hurry.
zh: 不知道我们还能撑多久，快点。

en: Hurry, Parker. The mercs know we're here.
zh: 快点，帕克，雇佣兵知道我们在这儿了。

en: Hurry, Parker. We're getting hit hard down here.
zh: 快点，帕克，我们这边被打得很惨。

en: We have to hurry before Masako sets off the bomb. Let's go.
zh: 得赶在雅子引爆炸弹之前，快走。

en: Come on, Parker. Hurry up.
zh: 来吧帕克，快点。

en: Come on, Parker. Come on.
zh: 来啊，帕克，快啊。

en: Watch it, Parker. Things are really bad up here.
zh: 当心，帕克，上面情况非常糟。

en: Move fast, Parker.
zh: 动作快点，帕克。

en: Ultor sent in guards to clean out the barracks.
zh: 乌尔托派警卫来清理兵营了。

en: Everything's been damaged, but the vents in the cafeteria kitchen used to lead toward the docking bay.
zh: 什么都被破坏了，不过食堂厨房的通风管以前是通向停靠区的。

en: Ultor has an interesting sense of humor, don't they?
zh: 乌尔托的幽默感还挺特别的，是吧？

en: Still trying to contact Eos in the Red Faction, Parker. No luck so far.
zh: 还在设法联系红色派系的伊欧丝，帕克，目前没有进展。

en: I've just spotted those miners. They fought their way almost to the docking bay.
zh: 我刚看到那些矿工了，他们一路打到了停靠区附近。

en: You'd better hurry if you want to get on that shuttle.
zh: 想赶上那班航天飞机的话，你最好快点。

en: Head for the elevator past the cafeteria. That'll take you to the docking bay.
zh: 往食堂那边的电梯走，那能带你到停靠区。

en: Not much farther now.
zh: 快到了。

en: Parker, this is Eos. The miners in the docking bay aren't in the Red Faction, so I have no control over them. Good luck trying to catch up to them.
zh: 帕克，我是伊欧丝。停靠区那些矿工不属于红色派系，我管不了他们。想追上他们的话，祝你好运。

en: Parker, I've contacted the Red Faction. I'm trying to patch Eos through to your comm set, but it might take a while, so keep moving.
zh: 帕克，我联系上红色派系了。我正设法把伊欧丝接进你的通讯器，可能要一会儿，你先继续走。

en: Up ahead is an elevator that should still be working.
zh: 前面有部电梯，应该还能用。

en: Sorry, Parker, looks like there's no escape that way. Keep moving while we figure out what to do.
zh: 抱歉帕克，那条路好像逃不出去。我们想办法，你先别停。

en: Keep going, Parker. There are guards all over the barracks now.
zh: 继续走，帕克，兵营里现在到处是警卫。

en: Told you. Now go up to the control room and activate the emergency doors so the docking bay can pressurize.
zh: 我说什么来着。现在上控制室，启动应急门，让停靠区能加压。

en: I think I can help you reach Eos and the Red Faction, but first we have to get you out of here.
zh: 我大概能帮你联系上伊欧丝和红色派系，但得先把你弄出去。

en: I told Eos you were coming down to their base. Now we just have to get you there.
zh: 我跟伊欧丝说了你要去他们基地，现在只要把你送到就行。

en: There's a huge bot up ahead, Parker. You can fight it or run past it, whichever you think is best.
zh: 前面有个大家伙，帕克。你可以打，也可以绕过去，自己看着办。

en: Parker, Eos here. Hendrix told me you're trying to reach us. Follow his directions and we'll see you soon.
zh: 帕克，我是伊欧丝。亨德里克斯说你想找我们，照他说的走，我们很快见。

en: I think you're stuck up there, Parker. There's no other way to get down here. Ultor's been sealing us off.
zh: 你恐怕是被困在上面了，帕克，没别的路能下来。乌尔托一直在封锁我们。

en: Don't go back up there, Parker. It's crawling with Ultor's goons.
zh: 别再上去了，帕克，上面全是乌尔托的打手。

en: You're welcome.
zh: 不客气。

en: Saw you go into that tube. I don't know where it goes, but keep moving and I'll spot you on a monitor somewhere.
zh: 看到你进那个管道了。我不知道它通向哪儿，你继续走，总能在某个监控上看到你。

en: I don't know, Parker. Things are pretty bad up there, but it's your neck.
zh: 我说不好，帕克，上面情况相当糟，不过是你自己的命。

en: Careful, Parker. There are guards up ahead. They took out those three miners.
zh: 小心，帕克，前面有警卫，那三个矿工就是他们干掉的。

en: There's a group of miners in the central ventilation shaft, Parker. See if you can catch up to them.
zh: 中央通风井里有一群矿工，帕克，看能不能追上他们。

en: Careful, Parker. More guards are heading your way.
zh: 小心，帕克，又有警卫往你那边去了。

en: Almost there, Parker.
zh: 快到了，帕克。

en: You might be able to trigger the bridge release lever with a well-placed shot, Parker.
zh: 瞄准点，一枪也许就能打中桥的释放杆，帕克。

en: One squad almost made it to the power plant before I lost contact with them. We need that plant taken out.
zh: 有一支小队差点就打到发电厂了，然后我就失去了联系。那座发电厂必须拿掉。

en: Glad it's you down there, not me, Parker.
zh: 幸好下去的是你不是我，帕克。

en: Get out of here! We're hiding until things calm down. Then we're gonna go back to Eos.
zh: 快走开！我们要躲到风头过去，然后回伊欧丝那儿。

en: Go away! Find someplace else to hide!
zh: 走开！找别的地方躲去！

en: Watch yourself, Parker. There are guards all over down here.
zh: 当心点，帕克，下面到处是警卫。

en: Guard post up ahead, Parker.
zh: 前面有岗哨，帕克。

en: Look for the steam vent shutoff. It should be a lever or a wheel.
zh: 找蒸汽阀的关闭装置，应该是个拉杆或者转轮。

en: Find the flow control panel and press the override button.
zh: 找到流量控制面板，按下强制解除键。

en: There's a manual control valve in here somewhere. Open it.
zh: 这里面有个手动控制阀，找到打开。

en: The sub bay's down this corridor. I think there's still a sub at the dock.
zh: 潜艇舱就在这条走廊尽头，我想码头那儿应该还停着一艘。

en: Glad to hear you made it, Parker. Great work on the power plant.
zh: 听说你出来了，太好了，帕克。发电厂那活儿干得漂亮。

en: Now we can fight back. I'm sending up squads to wreak some havoc.
zh: 现在我们能反击了，我这就派小队上去搅一搅。

en: Hendrix says you grabbed a sub. Head out through the underwater tunnels.
zh: 亨德里克斯说你搞到一艘潜艇，从水下隧道出去。

en: That sub's your only way out of here, Parker.
zh: 那艘潜艇是你唯一的出路，帕克。

en: The techs who work here live in the admin area, so there must be a way in.
zh: 在这儿上班的技师都住行政区，所以肯定有路进去。

en: There's an elevator on the far side of this floor.
zh: 这层楼的另一头有部电梯。

en: There's a security station to your right. You can disable the floor's cameras from there.
zh: 你右手边有个安保站，在那儿能关掉这层的摄像头。

en: There's a security station ahead of you. You can disable this floor's cameras from there.
zh: 你前面有个安保站，在那儿能关掉这层的摄像头。

en: Now get out of here before you get caught.
zh: 趁没被抓到，赶紧走。

en: The elevator to the exec suites is at the far end of the lobby.
zh: 去高管套房的电梯在大堂尽头。

en: You're running around in circles, Parker. Hurry up.
zh: 你在原地打转呢，帕克，快点。

en: Parker, be sure your weapon is holstered. The guards will spot you right away if it's out.
zh: 帕克，记得把枪收起来，掏出来警卫立刻就会发现你。

en: Remember, no hero stuff, Parker. Just grab Gryphon and get him out alive.
zh: 记住，别逞英雄，帕克。抓到格里芬，活着带出来就行。

en: Use whatever force is necessary, just don't kill him.
zh: 该用多大劲就用多大劲，别弄死他就行。

en: Hendrix says you've got Gryphon. Good work, now get him out of here.
zh: 亨德里克斯说你拿下格里芬了。干得好，现在把他弄出去。

en: Wait, Parker, the offices are back the other way.
zh: 等等帕克，办公室在另一边。

en: Gryphon's office is to the right. Good luck.
zh: 格里芬的办公室在右边，祝你好运。

en: What a jerk.
zh: 真是个混蛋。

en: What a jerk. Be on your toes, Parker.
zh: 真是个混蛋。打起精神，帕克。

en: There's a security station up ahead and to the left. You can disable this floor's cameras from there.
zh: 前面左手边有个安保站，在那儿能关掉这层的摄像头。

en: Don't hand Gryphon over to anyone but him.
zh: 除了他，别把格里芬交给任何人。

en: The control switch for the electric field is up in the guard post, Parker.
zh: 电场的控制开关在上面的岗哨里，帕克。

en: Orion Squad is being wiped out. Hurry up or there'll be no one left.
zh: 奥莱恩小队快被打光了，再不快点就一个都不剩了。

en: I've spotted a maintenance area at the far end. Head that way.
zh: 我在最里头看到一片检修区，往那边走。

en: Hurry, Parker. Ultor's sending reinforcements into the testing grounds.
zh: 快点，帕克，乌尔托在往试验场派增援。

en: Orion's on his way down with Gryphon. Great work, Parker.
zh: 奥莱恩正带着格里芬往下走。干得漂亮，帕克。

en: I'd like you to grab this Capek guy that Gryphon mentioned.
zh: 我要你去抓格里芬提到的那个卡佩克。

en: Sounds like he's the one who'd know how to stop the Plague.
zh: 听起来只有他知道怎么阻止瘟疫。

en: You're going to have to find them.
zh: 你得自己去找了。

en: It's going to cut you to pieces, Parker. Run.
zh: 那东西会把你剁碎的，帕克，快跑。

en: Kind of surprised you made it through that, Parker. Glad you did.
zh: 说实话没想到你能闯过来，帕克，还好你做到了。

en: I worked in the labs for a while. He scares the pants off me.
zh: 我在实验室干过一阵，那人吓得我魂都没了。

en: Don't fall into the pit, by the way.
zh: 对了，别掉进坑里。

en: Capek's fanatic about security. Be very careful.
zh: 卡佩克对安保近乎偏执，千万小心。

en: The guards here are trigger happy. Don't give them a reason to start shooting.
zh: 这儿的警卫扣扳机很快，别给他们开枪的理由。

en: The OR is at the far end of the lab complex.
zh: 手术室在实验楼群的最里面。

en: Don't get too close to the guards or the cameras.
zh: 别离警卫和摄像头太近。

en: The cryo lab's to your right.
zh: 低温实验室在你右边。

en: I've always been too scared of Capek to try this before, but I'm sick of being scared.
zh: 我以前太怕卡佩克，从来不敢试，可我受够了这么怕下去。

en: Stay with him and good luck, Parker.
zh: 跟紧他，祝你好运，帕克。

en: Stay with Capek, Parker! We can't lose him now!
zh: 跟住卡佩克，帕克！这时候不能让他跑了！

en: I'll choke the cure out of him if I have to.
zh: 必要的话，我掐也要把解药从他嘴里掐出来。

en: If you don't hear from me again, they probably caught me.
zh: 要是以后没我的消息了，多半是被他们抓了。

en: Ask nicely and the miner will open the door for you.
zh: 客气点问，那个矿工会给你开门的。

en: Like the sub, we stole it from Ultor.
zh: 跟那艘潜艇一样，是我们从乌尔托手里偷来的。

en: Climb in and take it for a ride, in case you have to drive a vehicle after we launch the revolt.
zh: 爬进去开一圈，起义之后说不定你就得开载具了。

en: Fire some torpedoes to get a feel for it.
zh: 打几发鱼雷找找手感。

en: Head for the other tunnel when you're ready to continue.
zh: 准备好了就往另一条隧道走。

en: Climb out of the sub and go up the stairs.
zh: 从潜艇里爬出来，上楼梯。

en: Open the gun cabinet and grab the pistol and sniper rifle.
zh: 打开枪柜，拿上手枪和狙击步枪。

en: Take some target practice here. Be sure to destroy all the bottles.
zh: 在这儿练练打靶，记得把所有瓶子都打碎。

en: Open up your message log and scroll through the messages I've sent you.
zh: 打开你的消息记录，翻看我发给你的消息。

en: This log automatically records messages that you receive.
zh: 这份记录会自动保存你收到的消息。

en: Reinforced glass is unbreakable. Go ahead, shoot it.
zh: 强化玻璃打不碎，你可以试试。

en: Normal glass can be shattered by weapon fire, allowing you into the room beyond.
zh: 普通玻璃能被枪火打碎，这样就能进到里面的房间。

en: The containers inside the room hold a rocket launcher and some remote charges.
zh: 房间里的容器装着一具火箭筒和几个遥控炸药。

en: Use these to blow a hole in the wall at the X.
zh: 用它们在打叉的地方炸开一个洞。

en: Once the hole's big enough, go through it, then get onto the elevator back to the mines.
zh: 洞够大之后穿过去，然后坐电梯回矿区。

en: Congratulations! You've passed the Red Faction training session.
zh: 恭喜！你通过了红色派系的训练课程。

en: Nothing more to shoot here, Parker. Keep moving.
zh: 这儿没什么可打的了，帕克，继续走。

en: This door's locked. You'll have to find another way around.
zh: 这扇门锁着，你得绕别的路。

en: The gauge in the upper right of your HUD shows how much ammo you have left.
zh: HUD 右上角的读数显示你还剩多少弹药。

en: The first number shows the rounds in your weapon. The second shows the extra rounds you're carrying.
zh: 第一个数字是枪里的子弹，第二个是你身上带的备弹。

en: Go through the door on your left to enter the target range.
zh: 从你左边的门进去，那是靶场。

en: Sometimes it pays to be inconspicuous. Holstering your weapon will help you blend in, since guns make people jumpy.
zh: 有时候不起眼反而有好处。收起武器会让你更容易混进去，因为枪会让人紧张。

en: Explosive weapons damage only softer materials, such as concrete, cement, or rock. Not harder materials, such as metal or steel.
zh: 爆炸武器只能破坏较软的材料，比如混凝土、水泥或岩石，对金属和钢材无效。

en: You must ask the miner to open the door before moving on to the next stage of training.
zh: 必须先让矿工开门，才能进入下一阶段的训练。

en: You have to shoot all the bottles before advancing to the next section of training.
zh: 必须打碎所有瓶子，才能进入下一节训练。

en: You must take the weapons from the cabinet before progressing on to the next training stage.
